question: By what percentage did unit sales of the 'Meridan Cascaed' change from 2024 to 2025? Give the product's ID and name with the percentage.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS pct_change FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.product_name = 'Meridian Cascade' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name LIMIT 500

answer: Assuming 'Meridan Cascaed' refers to 'Meridian Cascade', unit sales for Meridian Cascade (ID 32) increased by 67.57% from 2024 to 2025.
